content.user_title: Research Salaries and Jobs with Levels.fyi
content.value_statement: Salary and job comparisons need clear sources and consistent role, location, and level filters. This skill guides connected Levels.fyi queries and distinguishes sourced figures from estimates.
actual_capabilities: Routes company, location, and job-family names through lookup tools to obtain valid query slugs.
Selects tools for salary percentiles, company-level compensation, top-paying companies, location statistics, and recent salary submissions.
Guides searches for open jobs and retrieval of individual job details.
Looks up company vesting schedules and negotiation guidance through connected tools.
Requires source attribution and separates Levels.fyi tool data from website information and estimates.
Prepares data feedback for user approval and refers voluntary salary contributions to a separate skill.
limitations: Requires a working Levels.fyi connector; this skill does not implement or install the tools.
Tool coverage may differ from the website, and permissions or rate limits can restrict results.
Offer evaluation, offer comparison, pay benchmarking, and salary submission are delegated to separate skills not included here.
Contains workflow instructions rather than a bundled salary dataset or independently verified connector implementation.

use_cases.title: Research Compensation Before Negotiating
use_cases.description: Compare salary percentiles and company-level pay for a specific role and location before discussing an offer.

use_cases.title: Compare Hiring Markets
use_cases.description: Review company compensation and location statistics using consistent filters to inform hiring discussions.

use_cases.title: Explore Roles and Equity Schedules
use_cases.description: Find open jobs, inspect job details, and research company vesting schedules when planning a career move.

prompt_templates.title: Find Local Salary Percentiles
prompt_templates.prompt: Find software engineer salary percentiles in the San Francisco Bay Area using Levels.fyi. State the source and available time window.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Company Levels
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up Google and Meta software engineering levels. Compare available pay data for Google L5 and Meta E5 in New York.

prompt_templates.title: Research Jobs and Vesting
prompt_templates.prompt: Find product manager jobs in Seattle. Show details for three relevant listings and retrieve available vesting schedules for their companies.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Sourced Market Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare data scientist pay in Seattle and New York. Include percentiles, top-paying companies, recent submissions, source windows, and permission limits. Label estimates separately.

output_examples.input: What is the median software engineer salary in Seattle if the Levels.fyi connector is unavailable?
output_examples.output: The Levels.fyi connection is not set up; connect Levels.fyi in your application plugin or connector settings so I can answer.

output_examples.input: Levels.fyi has no product manager data for my company, Acme. Can you report the gap?
output: I will report missing product manager salary data for Acme to Levels.fyi, using the resolved company and role identifiers.
I will not include personal details. Do you agree to send this feedback?

best_practices: Specify the role, location, and company level before comparing compensation, and resolve names to valid slugs.
Check the source, coverage window, and access limits for each figure before drawing conclusions.
Review proposed feedback before approving submission, and provide a reply email only when you want a response.
anti_patterns: Treating estimates or unrelated website figures as Levels.fyi tool data.
Comparing compensation across different roles, locations, or time windows without acknowledging the differences.
Submitting feedback or salary information without explicit user agreement.

faq.question: Does this skill work without a Levels.fyi connection?
faq.answer: No. If the tools are unavailable, it asks you to connect Levels.fyi through your application settings.

faq.question: Which salary questions can it address?
faq.answer: It routes questions about salary percentiles, company levels, top-paying companies, location statistics, recent submissions, and vesting schedules.

faq.question: Can it search for open jobs?
faq.answer: Yes, through connected job tools. Profile-based searches require confirmation of the role, level, and location before searching.

faq.question: Does it submit my salary automatically?
faq.answer: No. It asks once after relevant compensation disclosure and refers an agreed contribution to the separate contribute-salary skill.

faq.question: How does it report incorrect or missing data?
faq.answer: It describes the feedback and waits for agreement before sending. A reply email is included only when you provide it for that purpose.

faq.question: Does it evaluate or compare job offers directly?
faq.answer: It refers offer evaluation and comparison to separate skills. This file documents data lookup and routing, not those complete workflows.
